newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady as crude supports in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady as crude supports in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE naphtha were steady on Monday as stronger crude prices lent support in an otherwise quiet market, traders said.
Barges were talked at around $174/$179 and cargoes at around $173/$178 cif NWE, but traders said the market was extremely quiet as players assessed positions for the week ahead.
Some said much would depend on the Asian market's progress over the next few days.
Asian naphtha prices were steady to softer on Monday despite stronger crude as ample supplies in the region dampened sentiment.
